label: Банк России - DailyInfo (веб-сервис)
terms_note: The Bank of Russia's public SOAP web service (documentation in Russian; WSDL https://www.cbr.ru/DailyInfoWebServ/DailyInfo.asmx?WSDL, 282 operations listed with Russian descriptions). The WSDL gives an http:// address; the same service answers on https. Answers are .NET DataSets: an inline XML schema followed by diffgram rows. A request the service cannot read (e.g. a missing FromDate) is a SOAP Fault with HTTP 500; an unknown currency code answers an empty DataSet (no error).

error_kinds.match: Server was unable to read request
error_kinds.note: SOAP Fault for a missing or malformed field

search_symbols.note: Currencies quoted daily (EnumValutes, Seld=false): symbol is the CBR code (R01235 = USD), name the English name, type the ISO letter code; the Russian name is raw.Vname. query matches any of them.

get_series.note: Official RUB rate per ONE unit of the currency (VunitRate; raw.Vcurs is per Vnom units) for every fixing day from start to end. series_id is the CBR code from search_symbols (R01235 USD, R01239 EUR, R01375 CNY). start and end (YYYY-MM-DD) are both REQUIRED by the service.

not_offered.get_candles: Official daily rates only, no OHLC.
not_offered.get_news: The service has no news operation (MainInfoXML returns key rates, not headlines).

live_check.notes: all read tools answered, schema-valid, pagination advances
